supported_form: supported-forms.md line 7-8: straight-line visible factory definition with positional literal argument; stored factory result in one eval cell; returned helper identity from an executed Name binding; enclosing factory locals stay distinct from module globals; globals are read at invocation
semantics: make(argv) returns the module-level function object `helper` (resolved by Name at the return). helper is defined at module scope, so its free name `argv` is a module global (LEGB: helper's enclosing scope is the module, never make's frame). make's parameter `argv` is a local of make and is invisible to helper. job() therefore runs subprocess.run with the module global argv bound at invocation time: ['pacman','-Q','r22-nhb-module'].
